name: Constrained-Text-Generation-Studio
headline: Humanizer-zh: Enhance AI Text Authenticity
short_description: Humanizer-zh is the Chinese version of the Humanizer tool, designed to remove traces of AI-generated text. It enhances the authenticity of content, making it more relatable and human-like, ideal for various applications in communication and marketing.
author: op7418

sections.overview:
Humanizer-zh is a Chinese-language tool designed to identify and eliminate common patterns of AI-generated writing. It helps editors, content creators, and writers transform AI-assisted text into more natural, human-sounding content by removing telltale signs of artificial generation. Based on Wikipedia's Signs of AI Writing guidelines, the tool provides pattern recognition and editing guidance across 24 AI writing modes. Perfect for reviewing Claude-generated content or improving authenticity in marketing, articles, and professional communications.
Enhancing marketing copy to better connect with target audiences.
Localizing and adapting content specifically for Chinese-speaking users.
Improving the authenticity of user-generated content for social media platforms.
Preparing AI-generated reports to make them more suitable for human readers.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install op7418/Humanizer-zh`
`git clone https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh`
sections.usage:
```
Humanize the following AI-generated text for a [TARGET_AUDIENCE] in [LANGUAGE]. Make it more engaging, conversational, and relatable. Ensure it maintains the original meaning while sounding natural and authentic. Here is the text: [AI_GENERATED_TEXT].
```
Copy

```
Original AI-Generated Text: 'The company's new product launch is scheduled for next month. It is expected to generate significant revenue and enhance customer satisfaction. The product features advanced technology and is designed to meet market demands.'

Humanized Text: 'Exciting news! Our team has been working hard, and we're thrilled to announce that our new product will hit the market next month. We believe it's going to be a game-changer, not just for our revenue but also for our customers. Packed with cutting-edge tech, it's been crafted to tick all the right boxes in today's competitive landscape. Stay tuned for more updates!'
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
